Heard counsel for the petitioners, Shri Sanjay Kumar Om, learned counsel for respondents Nos.1
& 2 and Shri Rajiv Gupta, learned Additional Chief Standing Counsel for the State-respondents.

2.  The instant petition has been filed praying for a writ of mandamus commanding the respondents to pay compensation to the petitioners for an area of 147.72 sq. meters of Arazi No.61, Village Shaha @ Peepal Gaon, Pargana & Tehsil Sadar, District Prayagraj alongwith 24% interest per annum for having taken over possession of the said land belonging to the petitioners without any formal Smt. sentences.text: 3. It is admitted to the petitioners that they agreed for transfer of 147.72 sq. meters of land required by the respondents for widening the runway of Bamrauli Airport, Prayagraj.
An agreement was also executed by the petitioners in favour of the State-respondents in this regard.
However, the grievance of the petitioners is that the respondents, after determining the compensation, are paying the same for an area of 45.57 sq. meters only.

4. Shri Rajiv Gupta, learned Additional Chief Standing Counsel submits that Government Order dated 12.05.2016, the District Level Committee is competent to examine the issue and determine compensation.

5. Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on merits at this stage, the writ petition is disposed of with liberty to the petitioners to approach respondent no.4 alongwith a fresh representation and true attested copy of the instant order raising their grievances.

Respondent no.4 will place the said representation before the District Level Committee for being considered and decided after proper hearing to the petitioners or other persons who are likely to be affected thereby.
The decision shall be taken within twelve weeks from the date the same is forwarded by the office of District Magistrate to the Chairperson of the Committee.
